description: This PHP file is part of the SuiteCRM administration module, specifically handling the diagnostic download process by serving diagnostic zip files to authorized users after validation and permission checks.

methods.name: Unauthorized access check
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has admin privileges and is authorized to access diagnostics.

methods.name: Diagnostics file existence check
methods.description: Confirms whether the diagnostic zip file exists before attempting to serve it.
